items.requirement: Preserve the complete website, hosted documentation, public records and deployment history.
Provide independent product routes, Apps, Download, Docs, API, Manual, FAQ, Security, Status and Support information architecture.
Render only owner-provided source-bound product, network, release, download and status facts.
Expose downloads only with immutable URL, SHA-256, bytes, signing class, minimum OS and install evidence.
Provide canonical URLs, metadata, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots, IndexNow and search-engine handoff.
Support responsive 390px layout, keyboard, focus, contrast, reduced motion, dark mode and RTL.
Provide bounded PWA caching without caching private or signed mutation state.
Enforce CSP, secret scanning, dependency review and fail-closed public API behavior.
Ingest all 35 owner product records without inventing missing public status or artifacts.
Verify the exact current source on the public production domain across all required routes and records.
Verify Search Console, Bing, IndexNow submission and index coverage with direct owner evidence.
Prove monitoring, incident, rollback, backup, support and accessibility regression gates for production.
Obtain approved owner product records, deployment authority and search-console ownership evidence.
Commit, push and source-bind the final website branch and handoff.
